name: hba-uigen
description: UI prototype generation panel (HBA FR-2): disk-as-truth screens store, multi-screen canvas, 390px preview, demo playback, HTML/JSX/Vue artifacts, import/export.

description_i18n.en: UI prototype panel migrated from HBA ui_gen (FR-2): generate multi-screen prototypes from a requirement prompt straight to the workspace disk (screens/ + index.json, no versioning), browse them on a zoomable/draggable canvas, preview in a 390px phone frame, play them as a demo, switch HTML/JSX/Vue artifacts, create/rename/delete screens on disk, import from a local directory and export.
description_i18n.zh-CN: UI 原型面板（HBA FR-2 迁移）：需求输入生成多屏原型并直接写入工作区磁盘（screens/ + index.json，无版本概念），画布缩放/拖拽，390px 手机预览，演示播放，HTML/JSX/Vue 产物切换，页面新建/重命名/删除真落盘，本地目录导入与导出。
